# THEME_SPEC — 8 themes (generated by `tools/themes.mjs`; do not edit by hand)

Sources: `reference/theme-references/*.png` sampled with `tools/sample_theme_refs.py` (exact-colour histograms of solid interiors; ink of thin strokes = median of the 8 % of pixels furthest from the background). Red and Green have no reference: Blue / Default structure with the Manual p.14 palette.

Button fills are not measured against the page: WCAG 1.4.11 does not require a control fill to contrast with its background when the text label identifies the control; every label is measured (on-accent on accent). The Default light gold button on #F5F2EE (2.16:1 fill, label 7.42:1) is the reference design.

Rules: small text ≥ 4.5:1 (target ≥ 7), display text (≥ 24 px or ≥ 18.66 px bold), icons, outlines and focus rings ≥ 3:1. No grey: secondary text is a theme-tinted colour. Pattern ink is decorative (exempt).

**Result: 232 pairs measured, 0 failures.**

## Button choice for #008BC4 fills (B2)

White label on #008BC4 = 3.83:1 fails for normal-size labels. Chosen everywhere a #008BC4 fill would appear (Blue dark mode, buttons on navy panels): **sky #98D0E8 fill with #0B3560 label = 7.40:1**. Blue light content keeps the reference navy button with a white label (10.36:1).
